Sources describe the appliance inconsistently (cordless handstick vs upright); the Israeli retailer page is the main Hebrew source and the Bosch spec sheet is the ZA-market version of the same model code.
Catalog and ZA spec sheet state a 10-year motor guarantee; Israeli importer terms not confirmed, so the fact was not published.
Catalog charge time of 5 hours is not confirmed by any source.
Catalog origin Germany is not confirmed by any source.
